scope: Synthetic native translation feasibility, not page/renderer/browser acceptance
routes: All 20 directed pairs among five languages; non-English pairs pivot through English with sequential model jobs
oracle: Every destination's five predefined semantic concepts must appear; alternatives are fixed before inference. This is a bounded positive test, not a universal linguistic-quality claim.
